context: Evaluates whether the candidate correctly uses the useSearch SWR hook from @vercel/commerce-kibocommerce for product catalog queries. Tests knowledge of the hook's input parameters (search, categoryId), return shape (products, found, isLoading, error), and correct rendering for loading, result, and empty states.

checklist.name: Uses useSearch hook
checklist.description: The component imports and calls useSearch from @vercel/commerce-kibocommerce, not a custom fetch.

checklist.name: Search parameter passed
checklist.description: The text input's current value is passed as the search parameter to useSearch.

checklist.name: Uses found property
checklist.description: The component uses the found property from the hook's return value to display result count or empty state.

checklist.name: isLoading handling
checklist.description: While isLoading is true, a loading indicator is rendered instead of results.

checklist.name: categoryId prop forwarded
checklist.description: When a categoryId prop is provided, it is passed to the useSearch hook as the categoryId parameter.
